items.title: How much does one skipped unit conversion actually inflate an estimate?
items.description: The unit's own numbers: 2,000,000 records at 5 KB each is genuinely 10 GB/day. Each skipped conversion step (KB→MB, then MB→GB) multiplies the reported figure by another 1,000x. Drag to 1 skipped conversion to reproduce the exact incident (10,000 GB reported vs. 10 GB actual).
